candidate_workaround: Record the no-match, use the live activation and exact committed baton as authority, and infer nothing from registry silence.
failure_signature: An exact-current registry lookup returns the search tool's no-match exit and provides no continuity evidence.
recurrence_guard: Never turn an absent memory hit into identity, continuity, or completion evidence.
rollback: Give the lookup zero continuity credit and retain the live request as the controlling authority.
scope_boundary: Read-only memory registry inspection only; no memory file is changed by the lookup.
title: Treat exact-current memory no-match as absence, not continuity
trigger_preconditions: The live activation refers to a phase newer than the current memory registry entries.
